text:
olivia: Heads up — PR #4122 is flaking on GH actions when the eval matrix includes quantized-8bit runs. Failures look nondeterministic and only happen under PR gate.
marc: saw that earlier. Are we sure it's the quant step and not artifact fetch? any logs?
olivia: logs attached (snippet):
```
EVAL ERROR: mismatch in perplexity calculation for quantized model
Traceback: AssertionError at eval_runner.py:243
```
olivia: it repros ~1/5 runs, sometimes only on ubuntu-latest.
ci-bot: buildkite/eval-runner-29 failed: timeout after 45m (retries:1) :red_circle:
devon: possible causes: jitter in runner matrix causing resource contention -> kv cache miss -> nondet token ordering... also GHA self-hosted runners getting thundering herd
sasha: can we split into a lightweight smoke gate for PRs (fast fp32-only checks) + full quant/nightly? that would cut PR noise.
marc: agree. propose matrix: pr: [smoke-fp32, smoke-embeddings], nightly: full-quant-x8, full-quant-x4, calibration
marc:```
strategy:
  matrix:
    job: [smoke-fp32, smoke-embeddings]
    include: [{job: full-quant-x8, run_on: nightly}]
concurrency:
  group: eval-ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
```
devon: +1. also add artifact-dedupe and a shared cache key for quant artifacts. buildkite-bot: artifact upload dedup hit: saved 1.2GB
sasha: we should also add a FAIL_FAST for PR smoke but continue-on-error for quant in PRs with a note linking to nightly report.
olivia: I'll spike the GH workflow changes and add a tiny dashboard panel in Grafana to show PR vs nightly pass rates over last 30d.
marc: file an issue to coordinate with infra for runner limits and add a label `ci-heavy` for PRs that need full quant.
olivia: assigning to me and devon. Thanks :pray:
buildkite-bot: scheduled nightly pipeline eval-quant-full at 03:00 UTC
olivia: will post a followup with the PR that updates workflows + smoke harness.
